description: What the shared Lua converter (layouts/xkb_converter.lua) must write for a hand-written layout with dead keys, a chained dead key, a multi-character output and XKB hints, with the ISO keycode table and the shipped keysym table and symbols template (static/ergopti/linux/xkb_generation/data). Expected files are the Python converter's; tools/test/test-keylayout-canonical-parity.cjs compares both converters on every shipped layout.

vectors.name: dead keys, chain, multi-character output, hints
vectors.keylayout:
<?xml version="1.1" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<keyboard group="126" id="-1" name="Conversion Probe">
<layouts><layout first="0" last="0" mapSet="s" modifiers="m"/></layouts>
<modifierMap id="m" defaultIndex="0">
 <keyMapSelect mapIndex="1"><modifier keys="anyShift"/></keyMapSelect>
 <keyMapSelect mapIndex="2"><modifier keys="caps"/></keyMapSelect>
 <keyMapSelect mapIndex="3"><modifier keys="anyShift caps"/></keyMapSelect>
 <keyMapSelect mapIndex="4"><modifier keys="command"/></keyMapSelect>
 <keyMapSelect mapIndex="5"><modifier keys="anyOption"/></keyMapSelect>
 <keyMapSelect mapIndex="6"><modifier keys="anyShift anyOption"/></keyMapSelect>
</modifierMap>
<keyMapSet id="s">
 <keyMap index="0">
  <key code="0" output="a"/>
  <key code="11" output="b"/>
  <key code="8" action="acute"/>
  <key code="2" action="circ"/>
  <key code="3" output="f"/>
  <key code="5" output="« "/>
  <key code="4" action="star"/>
  <key code="6" output="""/>
  <key code="7" output="\"/>
 </keyMap>
 <keyMap index="1"><key code="0" output="A"/><key code="11" output="B"/><key code="4" action="star"/></keyMap>
 <keyMap index="2" baseIndex="1"/>
 <keyMap index="3" baseIndex="1"/>
 <keyMap index="4"><key code="0" output="a"/></keyMap>
 <keyMap index="5"><key code="0" output="à"/><key code="8" action="acute"/><key code="4" action="star"/></keyMap>
 <keyMap index="6" baseIndex="5"/>
</keyMapSet>
<actions>
 <action id="acute"><when state="none" next="s1_acute"/>
  <when state="s1_acute" output="´"/>
  <when state="s2_circ" output="x"/></action>
 <action id="circ"><when state="none" next="s2_circ"/>
  <when state="s1_acute" next="s3_both"/></action>
 <action id="star"><when state="none" output="★"/>
  <when state="s2_circ" output="â"/></action>
 <action id="a"><when state="none" output="a"/><when state="s1_acute" output="á"/><when state="s2_circ" output="â"/></action>
 <action id="b"><when state="s3_both" output="BOTH"/></action>
</actions>
<terminators>
 <when state="s1_acute" output="´"/>
 <when state="s2_circ" output="^"/>
 <when state="s3_both" output="¨"/>
</terminators>
</keyboard>
